name: Project Heist
tagline: Plan it. Crack it. Get out clean.
kicker: Heist puzzle adventure for Android · working title
summary: Run a crew of quirky specialists from a secret HQ. Scout the target, slip past guards and cameras, crack hands-on 3D locks, safes and vaults, and get out clean.
description: You're the Mastermind. Pick a target on the city map, gather intel to reveal its floors and hidden rooms, choose your way in (a window, a skylight, the patio, the front door) and bring the right crew for the job.

Then play the heist live: steer your heroes past patrols and cameras, and every lock, keypad, laser grid, safe and vault is a hands-on 3D puzzle up close. If it goes wrong, it's a chase across the rooftops or through the streets, not a shoot-out.

features.title: Real-time heists
features.text: Steer your heroes room by room, dodging guards, cameras and alarms, with the floor plan revealed by the intel you gather.

features.title: Hands-on 3D puzzles
features.text: Pick tumbler locks, crack safes by feel, reroute patch panels, beat keypads, bend laser grids and open the vault.

features.title: A crew of specialists
features.text: Eleven quirky heroes, each with their own skills: climbers, hackers, talkers, safecrackers and getaway drivers.

features.title: Talk your way in
features.text: Bluff the front desk, work an inside contact and lift a key card from a guard's pocket.

features.title: Getaways, not gunfights
features.text: Botched a job? Run the rooftops, rappel down the building or lose the police in a car pursuit.

features.title: Your secret HQ
features.text: Grow a hideout behind a neon sign: new rooms unlock new crew, gear, research and bigger targets.
